name: Small Rectangular Pillow with Stylized Floral Decor
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；8th-9th century；Simulated 'Jiaotai' ware: pinkish buff earthenware with lead-fluxed, pale amber glaze over applique medallions consisting of thin layers of laminated clays; with underglaze brown slip painted between the medallions on top surface.
